reviews.text: I love the way my JOJO came out … he was done on time and fast. I love how clean he came out and they notified me about a red spot on the dog’s chest. I love the clothes I brought him as well. I will definitely be returning.

Wow!  Fun shop, with lots of dog fashion giftware, excellent grooming of my miniature poodle, caring & kind to anxious ones, good fair pricing, and done in just over an hour!  Very organized and sleek operation with friendly owner and staff.  Very impressed!  And I found out the owner can actually clean/scale teeth, as well as brushing.  I am going to have that done annually with Snip Dogg Doggy Spa!  I feel really lucky to have found this well run business!

Thank you for taking care of chi chi ! UPDATE:   We still love coming to snip doggy dog! I’ve tried other places and chi chi is not comfortable anywhere else. Thanks Sherry and the wonderful team of groomers you have!
It’s a nice place. Very professional people with great prices. I really love this place to bring my puppies. Lili muñeca and princess .

My 2 small dogs Mischief (long haired Chihuahua) and Chico (MaltyPoo) once again got ship-shaped and pampered by the fabulous
Snip Dogg crew✨✨✨✨✨
💖Thanks again!
Sherry and team always do an amazing job with my little one Shadow ! Definitely recommended bringing your loved one here, they will treat them like their own !

I’m extremely disappointed with my experience at this grooming salon. Every visit feels like an opportunity for unnecessary upselling over the smallest things. Despite booking appointments well in advance, they are consistently late and highly unprofessional with scheduling and communication.

What frustrates me the most is the grooming itself. Instead of taking the time to properly groom my dog, they immediately push to shave her down completely and claim she is “matted” when she only has a few minor knots here and there.. something that can absolutely be brushed out by a groomer willing to put in the effort. It honestly feels like they choose the quickest, laziest option while still charging premium prices.

A good groomer should prioritize the dog’s comfort, appearance, and proper care - not take shortcuts just because it’s easier and faster. I expected professionalism and quality care, but unfortunately this place delivers neither.

I do not recommend.

100% will be going back. I love that this is a cage free grooming!  I was able to watch the full process for my 15 week old puppy's first grooming.  She was handled with so much care and you can tell they absolutely love what they do! Selfie looks absolutely adorble. Thank you so much!
